quote: Sheer boredom for the first 20%.. it eventually steadies out a little with a repetitive predictable nothing new story with no new mechanics and features you don’t already know. Then the ending is so terrible, you find out you wasted your entire time thinking you could just enjoy the game the way you wanted too until you realize you were supposed to play the game being a good boyfriend and samaritan and then have to question yourself of did either one of them even really care about this child at all?? 13 years to leave you high and dry on a stupid cliff hanger that essentially rendered the entire game meaningless.. what a waste of time
